documents.title: Affidavit of Dana Reyes, sworn August 2, 2026
documents.text:
[Page 1]
I, Dana Reyes, of the City of Hamilton, make oath and say:
1. I am a child protection worker with the Society and have been assigned to this family since June 2026.
2. On July 14, 2026, the Society received a call from a community member who wished to remain anonymous. The caller reported that the children were often left without supervision in the evenings.
3. I verily believe the children are at risk of harm if they remain in the father's care.
[Page 2]
4. On July 20, 2026, I attended the home. The father was present with both children. The home was clean and there was food in the refrigerator.
5. I have not personally observed the children without supervision.
Sworn before me at Hamilton on August 2, 2026.
